title: Afan Mustafa launches Everything Claude Code open-source setup #anthropic #hackathon #aidevelopment
description: Afan Mustafa open-sourced Everything Claude Code, a project developed over 10 months that turns Claude into a full developer team with 181 skills, 47 sub-agents, and 79 ready-made commands. The setup includes tools for security scanning, memory optimization, and learning from past sessions, working across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini. This innovation demonstrates the power of modular AI skill integration, enabling rapid product development and automation. Using this setup, Afan built a startup in just 8 hours and secured the Anthropic Hackathon grand prize. Everything Claude Code represents a significant step towards scalable, efficient AI collaboration in software engineering.
